$comment: Single source of truth for the per-org home-screen icons. Read by scripts/generate-app-icons.mjs (renders the PNGs), app.config.ts (registers them with expo-alternate-app-icons) and src/lib/app-icon.ts (picks one for the active org). Colours sampled from the web org picker on 2026-10-02. After editing: node scripts/generate-app-icons.mjs, then rebuild the dev client (alternate icons are native).
